sets.title: 재활용 의류 봉제 구조의 세 가지 안
q_texts: A, B, C 안을 수선 용이성, 내구성, 생산 비용, 착용감과 외형 측면에서 비교하시오.
본문의 재활용 원단 특성을 B안에 적용하여, 착용 시험에서 오래 견딘 재킷에도 주름 불량이 생기는 이유를 솔기와 원단의 관계로 설명하시오.
만약 내가 김온유라면 어떤 안을 고를 것인지 밝히고, 본문에 나온 그 안의 문제 한 가지를 보완할 아이디어 하나를 제시하시오.

sets.title: 광장 야간 조명의 인상과 길 안내
q_texts: A, B, C 안을 시각적 인상, 이용자의 눈에 빛이 들어오는 방식, 안내 정보의 식별의 세 측면에서 비교하시오.
본문의 C안에 비 온 뒤의 상황을 적용하여, 광원을 가려도 안내가 잘 보이지 않을 수 있는 이유를 빛의 경로를 따라 설명하시오.
만약 내가 공간 디자이너라면 어떤 안을 고를 것인지 이유와 함께 밝히고, 안내 기능을 유지하며 그 안의 약점 하나를 줄일 보완 방안을 제시하시오.

sets.title: 학교 앱 첫 화면의 세 가지 안
q_texts: A, B, C 안을 정보 탐색 효율, 서툰 사용자의 접근성, 개발비와 유지 부담, 작동 속도와 오류 가능성 측면에서 비교하시오.
본문의 편집 기능 사용 조사 결과를 C안에 적용하여, 편집 기능을 쓰는 비율이 낮아도 교사 한 명의 전화 안내가 어려울 수 있는 이유를 설명하시오.
만약 내가 김도현이라면 어떤 안을 고를 것인지 밝히고, 본문에 나온 그 안의 문제 한 가지를 보완할 아이디어 하나를 제시하시오.

sets.title: 선물 포장을 고르는 사람과 여는 사람
q_texts: A, B, C 안을 구매 순간의 시각적 인상, 여는 부분의 발견, 개봉에 필요한 손동작의 세 측면에서 비교하시오.
본문의 점검 조건을 근거로, C의 구매 선호와 단계별 낮은 힘만으로 개봉 접근성이 높다고 판단하기 어려운 이유 두 가지를 설명하시오.
만약 내가 포장 디자이너라면 어떤 안을 고를 것인지 구매 인상과 혼자 여는 조건을 고려해 밝히고, 그 안의 약점 하나를 줄일 보완 방안을 제시하시오.

sets.title: 옛 공방 영상에서 기록과 창작을 표시하는 방법
q_texts: A, B, C 안을 영상에 대한 몰입, 내용의 범주 구별, 근거 확인 방식의 세 측면에서 비교하시오.
제시문의 구분 기준을 적용하여, 영상 속 지붕 높이와 장인들의 대화를 각각 어느 범주로 표시해야 하는지 이유와 함께 설명하시오.
만약 내가 전시 디자이너라면 어떤 표시 안을 고를 것인지 밝히고, 그 안에서 생기는 오해 한 가지를 줄일 보완 방안을 제시하시오.

sets.title: 생활시설의 상징을 누가 어떤 기준으로 정할 것인가
q_texts: A, B, C 선정 절차를 전문가 평가의 효력, 주민의 결정 권한, 참여의 대표성이라는 세 측면에서 비교하시오.
제시문의 판독 시험 결과를 B안과 C안에 적용하여, 인기 도안을 최종 후보로 남길 수 있는지 각각 이유와 함께 설명하시오.
만약 내가 공공 디자이너라면 어떤 선정 절차를 고를 것인지 밝히고, 그 절차의 참여상 약점 한 가지를 줄일 보완 방안을 제시하시오.

sets.title: 공공시설 안내를 글과 그림과 소리로 전달하는 방법
q_texts: A, B, C 안을 전달할 수 있는 정보, 이용자의 접근성, 여러 사람의 동시 이용이라는 세 측면에서 비교하시오.
제시문을 바탕으로, 혼잡 시간에 분실물을 찾는 방문객에게 C안이 줄 수 있는 도움과 남는 어려움을 한 가지씩 설명하시오.
만약 내가 안내 디자이너라면 어떤 안내 안을 고를 것인지 밝히고, 그 안의 이용상 약점 한 가지를 줄일 보완 방안을 제시하시오.

sets.title: 대피 앱에서 먼저 보여 줄 정보와 빠르다는 판단
q_texts: A, B, C 안을 첫 화면의 정보량, 경로 확인 절차, 잘못된 경로 선택의 위험이라는 세 측면에서 비교하시오.
제시문의 모의시험 결과를 바탕으로, B안을 모든 이용자에게 가장 빠른 대피 화면이라고 판단하기 어려운 이유를 대상과 측정 항목으로 나누어 설명하시오.
만약 내가 화면 디자이너라면 어떤 첫 화면 안을 고를 것인지 밝히고, 그 안의 이용상 약점 한 가지를 줄일 보완 방안을 제시하시오.

sets.title: Do urban green spaces make city residents healthier?
q_texts: According to Passage [B], what are the two reasons why green spaces improve residents' health, and what problem does the passage point out about how these benefits are shared?
Using Passage [B], explain why building parks only where land is easy to buy may keep the health benefits in Passage [A] from reaching low-income neighborhoods.
In your opinion, which one action should a city prioritize to share the health benefits of green spaces more fairly? Support your choice with one reason from the passages.

sets.title: Who benefits from cross-border student exchange?
q_texts: According to Passage [B], what are the two reasons why student exchange benefits both countries, and what limitation does the passage admit?
Using the limitation in Passage [B], explain why the growth in student exchange described in Passage [A] may not spread its benefits throughout both societies.
What is your opinion on using public money to widen access to student exchange? Support your position with one reason from the passages.

sets.title: Why do school cafeterias throw away so much food?
q_texts: According to the passages, how serious is food waste in school cafeterias, and what are the two causes explained in Passage [B]?
Using Passage [B], explain how allowing students to choose their serving size could reduce the food disposal costs described in Passage [A].
In your opinion, which should a school try first to reduce food waste: portion choice or student input on menus? Support your choice with one reason from the passages.

sets.title: Working hours in an international remote team
q_texts: Summarize the problem in passage [A] and the approach to cooperation in passage [B].
Using passage [B], explain how shared task notes could reduce the pressure to reply during dinner in passage [A].
In your opinion, when should a team member be expected to reply outside agreed working hours? Explain one rule with a reason from the passages.

sets.title: Can remote work revive small towns?
q_texts: Summarize the situation described in Passage [A] and explain the two reasons in Passage [B] why remote work can help small towns.
Using Passage [B], explain why attracting new families in Passage [A] may not keep a town's schools open if companies order workers back to the office.
In your opinion, can remote work help small towns recover in the long run? Support your position with one reason from the passages.

sets.title: Should public transport be free for everyone?
q_texts: What do the passages [A] and [B] tell us about the goals of fare-free public transport and about what actually happened in the city described in Passage [B]? Why did the free service fail to reduce car traffic?
Applying the goal of easier travel for low-income people in Passage [A], explain how the bus budget cuts in Passage [B] worked against that goal.
In your opinion, was the city in Passage [B] right to restore a small fare for working-age adults? Support your position with one reason from the passages.

sets.title: The true cost of cheap clothes
q_texts: Summarize the phenomenon described in Passage [A], and explain the two hidden costs of cheap clothing presented in Passage [B].
Using Passage [B], explain how the frequent buying and quick disposal described in Passage [A] can increase environmental costs even when clothes are cheap.
What is your opinion on buying cheap clothes to wear only a few times? Support your position with one reason from the passages.

sets.title: Ending the twice-a-year clock change
q_texts: According to Passages [A] and [B], why did countries begin changing their clocks, and why has that reason weakened? Explain also what makes it difficult for a country to end the practice.
Using [B], explain how keeping summer time all year would affect the winter school journeys mentioned in the passage, compared with keeping standard time.
In your opinion, should a country keep changing its clocks twice a year, or end the practice? Explain your view with one reason or one example from the passages.

sets.title: Is spending on space exploration justified?
q_texts: Summarize the debate described in Passage [A], and explain the two reasons that supporters of space budgets give in Passage [B].
Using [A] and [B], explain why using spacecraft materials in hospital equipment does not guarantee that hospitals waiting for equipment can obtain it now.
In your opinion, is government spending on space exploration justified? Support your view with one reason or one example from the passages.

sets.title: When disasters cross borders
q_texts: What do the passages [A] and [B] tell us about disasters that cross national borders? Summarize the main contents of each passage and the two views in Passage [B].
Using [A] and [B], explain why supplies stored near a border may still be delayed if customs rules remain unchanged.
Do you agree that neighboring countries should build a joint system for responding to disasters? Support your view with one reason or one example from the passages.

sets.title: Preventing or compensating climate damage
q_texts: Summarize the situation described in Passage [A] and explain the reasons each side gives in Passage [B].
Using [B], explain why spending the entire budget in [A] on future prevention could weaken the prevention plan itself.
In your opinion, should a limited climate budget go first to prevention or compensation? Explain your priority with one reason or one example from the passages.

sets.title: Recognizing skills acquired abroad
q_texts: Summarize the recognition problem in passage [A] and the principle for assessing qualifications in passage [B].
Drawing on passage [B], explain why the untested knowledge in passage [A] does not justify treating all the worker's skills as unproven.
In your opinion, should the worker in [A] begin supervised work before the local safety test? Support your position with one reason considering both access to work and service safety.

sets.title: Is water a basic right or a priced product?
q_texts: According to Passage [B], what are the two reasons for treating water as a priced product and the two reasons for treating it as a basic right?
Using [B], explain one benefit and one risk of charging for water in a city that keeps its water system in public hands.
Do you think a city should give priority to covering water costs or guaranteeing basic water access? Explain your view with one reason or one example from the passages.

sets.title: Is it fair to show different customers different prices?
q_texts: What do the passages [A] and [B] tell us about how personalized pricing works? Summarize the three reasons given in support of the practice and explain how the critics answer the third one.
Using [A] and [B], explain why comparing the two displayed shoe prices alone does not tell the friends whether the pricing rule is fair.
In your opinion, which matters more for fair personalized pricing, wider access or knowing the pricing rules? Explain your choice with one reason or one example from the passages.

sets.title: Language support at a public service counter
q_texts: Summarize the main issue in passage [A] and the two forms of language support in passage [B].
Using passage [B], explain why the shorter processing time in passage [A] does not establish better access for residents using minority languages.
Which form of support in passage [B] do you think the office should fund first? Explain your choice using one criterion and a detail about residents in passage [A].

sets.title: Who should explain a digital heritage collection?
q_texts: Summarize the main contents from each passage in the order [A], [B], and [C].
Using [B] and [C], explain one benefit and one concern about posting the images in [A] before the community's explanations are ready.
What is your opinion on requiring community approval of descriptions before publishing the cloth images in [A]? Support your idea with concrete reasons and examples.

sets.title: Should schools move to a four-day week?
q_texts: Summarize the main contents from each passage and provide the supporting reasons in Passages B and C.
Using [B] and [C], explain how a school's higher attendance can coexist with greater burdens on families where all adults work.
What is your opinion on a four-day school week? Support your idea with concrete reasons and examples.

sets.title: More visitors and clear routes through a town
q_texts: Summarize the main contents from each passage in the order [A], [B], and [C].
Applying [B] and [C], explain one way that directing the extra ferry's morning tour groups to the waterfront would help visitors and one way it would help residents.
What is your opinion on keeping the residential lane closed to tour groups before noon while allowing more tourists into the town? Support your idea with concrete reasons and examples.

sets.title: Refund help when an overseas seller does not reply
q_texts: Summarize the main contents from each passage in the order [A], [B], and [C].
Using [B] and [C], explain one reason the platform should handle the complaint in [A] and one reason the receipt alone cannot justify a refund.
What is your opinion on requiring the platform to arrange a refund when a seller remains silent after a stated response period? Support your idea with concrete reasons and examples.

sets.title: Should pet owners be required to hold a license?
q_texts: Summarize the main contents from each passage and provide the supporting reasons in Passages B and C.
Using [B] and [C], explain why registration may help return a lost dog but fail to identify an owner who skips registration.
What is your opinion on requiring a license to own a dog? Support your idea with concrete reasons and examples.

sets.title: Should school rankings be published?
q_texts: Summarize the main contents from each passage and provide the supporting reasons in Passages B and C.
Using [B] and [C], explain how publishing each school's progress from its students' starting level could address one concern in each passage.
What is your opinion on publishing school rankings? Support your idea with concrete reasons and examples.

sets.title: Should students be paid for good grades?
q_texts: Summarize the main contents from each passage and provide the supporting reasons in Passages B and C.
Using [B] and [C], explain why increased study time during payments does not show that students will keep studying after payments end.
What is your opinion on paying students for good grades? Support your idea with concrete reasons and examples.

sets.title: Sharing a road report before its meaning is checked
q_texts: Summarize the main contents from each passage in the order [A], [B], and [C].
Compare how the teams in [B] and [C] would use the bridge report in [A] when planning a delivery, giving one use permitted by each.
What is your opinion on requiring a source, observation time, and checking status before disaster reports enter a shared international map? Support your idea with concrete reasons and examples.

sets.title: How much of a joint research method should be public?
q_texts: Summarize the main contents from each passage in the order [A], [B], and [C].
Using [B] and [C], explain one benefit and one limitation of publishing results and test conditions while restricting the detailed failure instructions in [A].
What is your opinion on temporarily limiting public access to the detailed failure instructions from this international research project? Support your idea with concrete reasons and examples.

sets.title: Should influencer advertising follow stricter rules?
q_texts: Summarize the main contents from each passage and provide the supporting reasons in Passages B and C.
Using [B] and [C], explain what a paid partnership label tells viewers and what they still need to check about a product claim.
What is your opinion on making stricter rules for influencer advertising? Support your idea with concrete reasons and examples.

sets.title: One assessment across different learning conditions
q_texts: Summarize the main contents from each passage in one or two sentences per passage.
Using [B] and [C], explain one benefit and one limitation of giving every student the same extra time in [A].
What is your opinion on offering translated questions and replacing verified lost time under one scoring standard? Support your idea with concrete reasons and examples.

sets.title: Shared orbits and responsibility before movement
q_texts: Summarize the main contents from each passage in one or two sentences per passage.
Based on [B] and [C], explain why publishing the initial paths in [A] supports access but does not ensure safety after both paths change.
What is your opinion on requiring a joint safety check before satellite operators change their paths? Support your idea with concrete reasons and examples.

sets.title: Electricity exchange when both partners face shortages
q_texts: Summarize the main contents from each passage in one or two sentences per passage.
Based on [B] and [C], explain why stopping the delivery in [A] to protect factory production differs from stopping it to protect the exporter's hospital.
What is your opinion on requiring countries to fulfill promised electricity deliveries without exceptions during a shared shortage? Support your idea with concrete reasons and examples.

sets.title: Urgent warnings across languages
q_texts: Summarize the main contents from each passage in one or two sentences per passage.
Using [B] and [C], explain one benefit of translating the evacuation order in [A] immediately and one risk of dropping the road condition.

What is your opinion on requiring a final check of action words and safety conditions before sending every multilingual emergency warning, including messages prepared in advance, even if this delays delivery? Support your idea with concrete reasons and examples.

sets.title: Should companies pay a tax on robots that replace workers?
q_texts: Summarize the main contents from each passage and provide the supporting reasons in Passages B and C.
Using [B] and [C], explain how taxing profits to fund retraining addresses the funding need in [B] and the definition problem in [C].
What is your opinion on taxing robots that replace human workers? Support your idea with concrete reasons and examples.

sets.title: 수치가 된 몸
q_texts: 제시문 [나]에 나타난 자기 관리와 자기 감시의 차이를 설명하고, 제시문 [가]의 걷기 대회에서 나타난 참가자들의 모습을 그 차이에 근거하여 비교하시오.
제시문 [나]의 기록 목적 구별을 적용하여, 제시문 [다]의 윤서가 앱을 다시 설치한 뒤 기록의 용도를 어떻게 바꾸었는지 구체적인 변화 두 가지를 근거로 설명하시오.
제시문 [다]를 참고하여, 건강 앱의 숫자를 대하는 바람직한 자세를 자신의 사용 원칙 한 가지와 그 이유로 설명하시오.

sets.title: 폭염 속 작업을 멈추는 조건
q_texts: 제시문 [가]에서 공통 중지 기준과 개인의 이상 신호가 작업을 멈추는 시점을 정할 때 각각 어떤 역할을 하는지 비교하시오.
제시문 [나]를 바탕으로 [다]의 노동자가 휴식실이 있는데도 쉬겠다는 말을 거둔 이유를 임금과 동료의 부담 측면에서 설명하시오.
당신이 [다]의 사용자라면 노동자가 몸의 이상을 바로 알릴 수 있도록 무엇을 바꾸겠는지, 실행 방안 한 가지와 그 이유를 제시하시오.

sets.title: 통증을 말하는 방식
q_texts: 제시문 [나]에 제시된 통증을 전하는 두 방식을 비교하고, 제시문 [가]의 통증 점수를 둘러싼 문제가 두 방식과 어떻게 관련되는지 설명하시오.
제시문 [가], [나]를 바탕으로, 제시문 [다]에서 차트에 문장을 덧붙인 일이 통증 점수의 한계를 어떻게 보완했는지 설명하시오.
제시문 [다]의 노인이 통증 점수를 낮춰 말한 사정을 고려하여, 의료진과 환자의 소통에 필요한 자세를 자신의 실천 방안 한 가지와 그 이유로 설명하시오.

sets.title: 결정 지원 화면과 보호자의 선의
q_texts: 제시문 [나]에 제시된 자기결정의 세 조건을 설명하고, 제시문 [가]의 설명회에서 가족 대표와 개발자가 각각 어느 조건을 근거로 삼고 있는지 밝히시오.
제시문 [나]의 자발과 표현 조건을 적용하여, 제시문 [다]에서 딸의 대리 입력 제안과 마지막 동석 장면을 각각 설명하시오.
당신이 제시문 [다]의 딸이라면 아버지의 다음 치료 결정에 어떻게 참여할지, 제시문 [나]의 조건 하나를 근거로 행동 한 가지와 그 이유를 설명하시오.

sets.title: 유전자 검사 결과와 모를 권리
q_texts: 제시문 [나]에서 알 권리와 모를 권리를 어떻게 구별하는지 설명하고, 그 구별에 비추어 제시문 [가]의 김○○과 박○○ 중 누구의 주장이 [나]의 관점에 가까운지 이유와 함께 설명하시오.
